start-prompt.json.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, identity-preserving exercise illustration. Asset: CRESUM Male pull-up START, one single landscape 3:2 image.
REFERENCE: supplied image is the approved five-view CRESUM Male Master. Output ONE man only, matching his face, short brown hair, clean-shaven young adult identity, realistic athletic build and full-length adult limb proportions. Match exact muted blue-gray fitted T-shirt, dark gray shorts, white training socks, light gray trainers. Natural even skin tone/fine texture and cohesive matte fabric.
SCENE: plain white seamless studio background, soft natural grounding shadows. One physically coherent freestanding pull-up frame: two straight dark matte square-steel vertical uprights, one simple straight round horizontal grip bar rigidly attached across their tops, stable elongated floor feet and restrained structural joints. No assisted pull-up equipment, seat, knee pad, weights, cables or extra grips. Frame fully supported on the floor, not floating. Bar high enough that the adult man hangs fully off floor; floor feet extend fore/aft safely outside his feet's path. Entire frame and athlete in view with clean margins.
POSE: bottom START of unassisted OVERHAND bodyweight pull-up. Man suspended below the straight bar by BOTH hands. BOTH arms extend overhead comfortably straight, not bent top-phase elbows. Grip moderately wider than shoulders, symmetric, PRONATED palms facing away from the face. Each hand actually wraps the same bar with four natural fingers and an opposing thumb, secure closed grip, neutral wrists aligned with forearms. Bar in front of the hands' finger pads and enclosed by fingers, not intersecting wrists, no straps. Head neutral and centered below bar, gaze forward, neck not craned; torso vertical, abdomen gently braced, controlled shoulders with no exaggerated shrug, no arching/swinging. Hips under shoulders. Knees gently flexed, lower legs angled slightly behind body, ankles loosely crossed once to stabilize lower limbs. Both shoes visibly suspended above floor with clear gap and no contact with the frame. No kicking, knee lift or forward swing. Natural full-length arms/legs. Bottom START only; chin clearly BELOW bar, comfortably extended elbows; never portray a partly completed upward pull.
CAMERA: natural three-quarter FRONT view with slight side offset, at a useful height showing his face, both overhand grip contacts, shoulders, torso and complete legs, with physically correct perspective and restrained lens distortion. Man fills most of image height; frame surrounds him without occluding anatomy. Preserve plenty of space ABOVE the head inside frame for the later FINISH. No extreme wide angle, tiny figure or cropped bar/base/shoes.
STYLE: clean premium semi-realistic CRESUM 3D catalog rendering matching reference. Coherent blue-gray fabric, natural fine skin and hands, consistent dark matte steel, subtle restrained metal reflections. No patchy/waxy skin, saturated/glossy shirt, exaggerated bodybuilder muscles, shortened limbs, extra fingers/hands/arms, merged grip geometry or impossible supports. No text, arrows, labels, numbers, branding, watermark, inset, split-screen, muscle overlay or multiple men. One image, START only.
Technique source: ACE Pull Ups /191, controlled hang with full overhand grip, neutral wrists, braced trunk and gently crossed legs. Straight-bar frame and moderate width are illustrative choices within existing overhand pull-up scope, no canonical catalog change.

finish-prompts.json.initial:
Use case: identity-preserve, precise exercise-phase edit. EDIT IMAGE 1 ONLY, the user-approved CRESUM overhand pull-up START. Produce matching FINISH/top phase, one landscape 3:2 frame. Image 2 is actual original five-view Male Master, identity/outfit/skin/material reference only.
LOCK: exact same man, face, short brown hair, adult body proportions, muted blue-gray T-shirt, dark gray shorts, white socks and light gray trainers. Same perspective, lens, framing, crop, white studio background, soft lighting. Preserve entire pull-up frame exactly: both uprights, their holes/bolts, same straight bar height, diameter, bar connections, base feet, floor contacts and shadows. Do not raise/lower/bend the bar or change the camera.
ONLY INTENDED CHANGE: move this same suspended man UP to a coherent completed bodyweight OVERHAND PULL-UP. Keep BOTH hands at EXACT same fixed points of the same overhead bar with EXACT same closed PRONATED grips/width, opposing thumbs and natural finger contact. Hands and bar remain fixed in world coordinates. Flex both elbows and guide them down alongside the trunk as shoulders and chest rise toward the bar. FINISH with chin approximately LEVEL WITH OR SLIGHTLY ABOVE the bar, neck neutral and head vertically aligned with trunk; no reaching chin forward/up, exaggerated head tilt or craning. Bar passes in FRONT of upper chest/below chin with physically correct depth, not through neck/face, and never behind the head. Lift the WHOLE torso/hips/legs coherently by the arm pull; shoulders controlled, natural scapular motion, no exaggerated shrug or backwards lean. At top elbows are bent down beside ribs, not flared upward or floating; both sides clearly same top phase allowing perspective. Do not turn this into a chin-up/supinated grip, behind-neck pull-up, dip or half rep.
Keep trunk upright, abdomen braced, no lumbar arch/swing. Preserve same gentle knee bend and same loosely crossed ankle relationship/leg lengths: feet move UP together with the body, no kick or new knee tuck. Shoes remain fully airborne with larger floor gap. Do not keep feet at previous floor height while compressing legs. Frame unchanged; all original extremities/equipment remain uncropped. Maintain anatomically plausible shoulder-elbow-wrist chain with hands anchored to bar. No duplicated or merged hands, wrists through bar, extra fingers or limbs.
Preserve coherent natural fine skin detail and even skin color, same matte blue-gray shirt fabric and dark shorts with only natural changed folds near shoulders/elbows/waist. Keep original character face proportions and quality; no waxy/patchy skin, shiny/saturated shirt, painted color blocks, melted steel or changed supports. FINISH only, single frame; no inset, split screen, text, arrows, numbers, labels, logos, watermark or muscle overlay. Match clean premium CRESUM semi-realistic 3D rendering.
Movement source: ACE Pull Ups /191, controlled upward body motion, elbows down, neutral wrists/spine, chin level with bar, no swinging.
finish-prompts.json.repair:
Precise CRESUM exercise FINISH repair. Image1 is the failed FINISH to REPAIR. Image2 is approved START for exact frame/grip/body proportions; image3 actual original Male Master for identity/materials. Produce ONE landscape3:2 corrected top phase of an OVERHAND pull-up. Critical errors to fix: chin is BELOW the bar and top of head is CROPPED. Both must be corrected.
REFRAME: pull camera back slightly keeping same front three-quarter direction, add generous WHITE SPACE above the frame. Whole top of head MUST be visibly inside frame with a comfortable margin. Position bar approximately22% down from image TOP, so sufficient vertical space exists above the bar for the whole head and margin. Entire existing frame including floor base and athlete stay fully visible. This necessary reframing is allowed; preserve perspective direction and machine geometry and relative proportions. Do NOT merely move bar lower independently; the SAME frame and bar must be uniformly reframed together.
POSE: fixed hands remain on SAME bar at SAME moderately wider-than-shoulder grip spacing, CLOSED OVERHAND/pronated grip with opposing thumbs, wrists neutral. Raise the WHOLE BODY farther up until CHIN IS CLEARLY JUST ABOVE THE BAR'S TOP EDGE. The mouth, nose, eyes and entire head are ABOVE the bar; bar crosses in front of the UPPER CHEST/near collarbone level, NEVER across mouth or nose, NEVER through neck. No head stretching/craning. Neutral neck, gaze forward, upright torso, shoulders controlled. Both elbows bent and drawn downward/back beside torso at the completed pull-up top, no half-rep. Reconstruct physically plausible elbow/shoulder geometry for this higher position with both hands anchored. Same upright braced torso, same hips/legs, gently bent knees and same loosely crossed ankles, suspended shoes, no kicking or knee tuck. Body rises as rigid torso+hips+legs system with normal limb lengths, no shortening/compression.
Preserve exact character, face/hair, muted blue-gray shirt, darkgray shorts, whitesocks, lightgray trainers, natural even skin/fabric texture. SAME two square-steel uprights, horizontal straight round bar, all holes/bolts/braces/base feet, no added parts. White seamless background, soft natural lighting, premium clean semirealistic 3D. No altered grip, extra digits/limbs, shaft through body, melted metal, skin patches, waxy surfaces or clothing color drift. One single FINISH frame, no insets/splitview/text/arrows/logos/watermarks. PRIORITY: full uncropped head, chin ABOVE bar, accurate completed overhand pull-up.
finish-prompts.json.pairFraming: FINISH reframed to include complete head above bar; align START presentation before runtime integration without changing its accepted pose.

aligned-start-prompt.json.prompt:
Precise CRESUM pair alignment / phase edit. EDIT IMAGE1 ONLY, the user's SELECTED FINISH. Produce its matching START bottom-hang pose with EXACT same composition. Image2 is original approved START for POSE ONLY, do not copy its tighter framing or different frame dimensions. Image3 actual five-view Male Master identity/outfit/material only.
LOCK IMAGE1: keep its entire freestanding dark steel frame, both square uprights, exact straight round grip bar height/diameter/end connections, all holes/bolts/braces, base feet, floor contacts/shadows, exact camera viewpoint, lens, crop, landscape3:2 canvas, white background and lighting. The frame and bar must stay fixed at the same image coordinates. SAME hands at SAME fixed bar contact positions and width with exact closed OVERHAND/pronated grip and opposing thumbs. Do not move bar or hands to follow lowered body. Do not zoom or recrop.
ONLY CHANGE PHASE: lower same man from selected FINISH into controlled full START hang. Extend BOTH elbows comfortably straight, not hyperextended, with arms overhead and shoulders controlled, no exaggerated shrug. Lower whole head/torso/hips/legs naturally beneath these anchored hands, consistent adult arm length and shoulder geometry. Chin well below bar, head/neck neutral, gaze forward, torso upright, abdomen gently braced. Preserve same face/hair, body proportions and limb lengths. Same gentle knee bend, same loosely crossed ankles/relative leg positions, feet lower with body, still visibly OFF floor and clear of every frame base part. Do not stand him on the ground, compress the legs or lift knees to cheat. No swinging, kicking, back arch or torso rotation. Match the controlled hang in image2 but keep ALL image1 framing/equipment/grip.
Maintain exact CRESUM Master identity, muted bluegray T-shirt, darkgray shorts, white socks, lightgray shoes, natural even fine skin and coherent matte materials. Only natural pose-related shirt folds/shadows may change. No hand/bar intersections, extra fingers/limbs, supinated or mixed grip, clothing color drift, waxy/patchy skin, melted steel, shifted bases or cropped extremities. The result should pair directly with image1 by changing only the athlete's movement phase. START only, one image, no text/arrows/labels/logos/watermarks/insets/splitview.

selectionNote: Initial START selected, first FINISH rejected for cropped head/chin below bar, corrected FINISH selected via user-uploaded JPEG, reframed START subsequently selected. JPEG and generated corrected FINISH PNG are different byte sources; runtime FINISH exports the exact selected uploaded JPEG.
